parsed_json.up: Select chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, efo_id as indication_curie, efo_term as indication_label, max_phase_for_ind from molecule_dictionary joined to drug_indication on molregno, left joined to compound_structures on molregno. Filter molecule_dictionary max_phase = 4, efo_id is not null, efo_term is not null. Return distinct rows over the six output columns. Sort by all six columns ascending.
